summary:
Enter in the agenda app now jumps to the earliest later day with an event, and stays put if there is none; both the existing and the new tests pass.

I added an `enter` branch to `key` in `desk:apps:agenda` (lines 14–27), leaving `draw` and the left/right handling unchanged. I also added `desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests` with two tests covering the jump (with events out of order) and the no-later-event case. The app does not read or change any pages.

files.desk:apps:agenda:
app 'Agenda'
task start()
  set events to []
  for each p in pages('calendar')
    add fields(p) to events
  done
  give {events: events, day: today()}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'right'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, 1)
  or when k is 'left'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, -1)
  or when k is 'enter'
    set best to ''
    for each e in s.events
      when e.date > s.day
        when best is ''
          set best to e.date
        or when e.date < best
          set best to e.date
        done
      done
    done
    when best is not ''
      set s.day to best
    done
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change the day')
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'
task ev(d, n)
  give 'date: ' & d & newline() & 'time: 10:00' & newline() & 'title: ' & n
done
test 'enter goes to the next day that has an event'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds ev('2026-12-05', 'Trip')
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds ev('2026-12-03', 'Standup')
  pretend 'calendar:e3' holds ev('2026-12-01', 'Dentist')
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-03 thursday'
  check screen_line(3) is '10:00 Standup'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
  check app_open()
done
test 'enter does nothing when no later day has an event'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds ev('2026-11-30', 'Old')
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check app_open()
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

test 'it shows the events of today, by time'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00' & newline() & 'title: Dentist' & newline() & 'with: '
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 09:30' & newline() & 'title: Standup' & newline() & 'with: team'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
  check screen_line(4) is '15:00 Dentist'
done

test 'right goes to the next day'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'right'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-02 wednesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '(no events)'
done
